claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 254 (Classifying spaces and geometric obstructions for Artin groups.; papers: Harmonic heights and the Artin K(pi,1) conjecture; An Artin group with no geometric CAT(0) action; Parabolic intersections in Artin groups; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/254.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For any integer q and actual coset A_J x whose fixed exterior (I minus J) union boundary(I) is capped at q and has level-q counts c, it is impossible that every representative capped on I has m_j^q > c_j for every j in J; for empty J the exterior itself is impossible.

The graded algebra has a symmetric nondegenerate complementary-path Frobenius trace; the color twist bimodules are homotopy-invertible, satisfy the Artin relations, commute with right label tensoring, and preserve both-graded Hom cohomology. These are cat:frobenius and cat:action, scoped as manuscript inputs rather than conclusions of external literature.

The actual family has positive folded weights, label-proportional tops and socles, exterior generator invariance, and each individual transported projective has connected minimal color support containing its unchanged f-generator (cat:family and lay:labels).

Positive twists have layer amplitude [0,1], the adjacent-layer sequence, the bottom multiplicity formula with old top, zero acted socle, preservation of zero socle on J, and bottom braid relations; cap accessibility and top-zero cap preservation hold (lay:adjacent, lay:positive, lay:bottom, cap:access).

Under the universal strict lower bounds on all jointly capped representatives, the excess over the spherical harmonic interpolation is in the ordinary interior of the finite convex hull of folded dimensions of actual graded subrepresentation families supported on J (strict part of cap:hull).

For pure layers the length-j linear Hom cohomology pairs perfectly with reverse length-(2-j) cohomology in complementary bidegrees; its length Euler form is the unfolded Cartan form; for all pairs of layers of the same actual transported family h_1=0, also after replacing either layer by a pure direct summand (null:hom).

If the actual family is capped at q on I and M_L is a pure direct summand of its q-layer supported on I, then for every d<q and n+v=d-q, the secondary Hom differential injects H_0^(n,v)(M_L,Y^d E_H) into H_2^(n+1,v)(M_L,Y^(d-1) E_H); its weighted inequality is h_0(M,Y^d)<=h_0(Y^(d-1),M) (null:injection).

With q-layer pure direct summands M supported on I of folded dimension m, excess m-c supported on J and interior to the stated actual subrepresentation hull, a family layer Y^d with no socle on J has zero boundary(I) counts, zero Cartan rows on J, and zero linear Hom in both directions with M (null:separation).
In the target exterior configuration I minus J is nonempty and the actual family has a fixed occupied boundary(I) level strictly below q, even when f is not adjacent to I.

import Mathlib

namespace NullLayerAudit

section Linear

variable {K E M A H : Type*} [Field K]
  [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E]
  [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
  [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A]
  [AddCommGroup H] [Module K H]

theorem middleExact
    (D : E →ₗ[K] E) (i : M →ₗ[K] E)
    (p : E →ₗ[K] M) (p₀ : E →ₗ[K] A) (a : A →ₗ[K] M)
    (unit token : E) (f g : E →ₗ[K] K)
    (span : ∀ z, D z = 0 →
      ∃ (r s : K) (u : E), z = r • unit + s • token + D u)
    (funit : f unit = 1) (ftoken : f token = 0)
    (gunit : g unit = 0) (gtoken : g token = 1)
    (fD : ∀ u, f (D u) = 0) (gD : ∀ u, g (D u) = 0)
    (fi : ∀ x, f (i x) = 0) (gi : ∀ x, g (i x) = 0)
    (pi : ∀ x, p (i x) = x)
    (pD : ∀ u, p (D u) = a (p₀ u))
    (x : M) (hx : D (i x) = 0) :
    ∃ y, a y = x := by
  obtain ⟨r, s, u, hu⟩ := span (i x) hx
  have hr : r = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg f hu
    simpa [funit, ftoken, fD, fi] using h.symm
  have hs : s = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg g hu
    simpa [gunit, gtoken, gD, gi] using h.symm
  have hu' : i x = D u := by simpa [hr, hs] using hu
  refine ⟨p₀ u, ?_⟩
  calc
    a (p₀ u) = p (D u) := (pD u).symm
    _ = p (i x) := congrArg p hu'.symm
    _ = x := pi x

theorem middleExactAcyclic
    (D : E →ₗ[K] E) (i : M →ₗ[K] E)
    (p : E →ₗ[K] M) (p₀ : E →ₗ[K] A) (a : A →ₗ[K] M)
    (exact : ∀ z, D z = 0 → ∃ u, D u = z)
    (pi : ∀ x, p (i x) = x)
    (pD : ∀ u, p (D u) = a (p₀ u))
    (x : M) (hx : D (i x) = 0) :
    ∃ y, a y = x := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exact (i x) hx
  refine ⟨p₀ u, ?_⟩
  calc
    a (p₀ u) = p (D u) := (pD u).symm
    _ = p (i x) := congrArg p hu
    _ = x := pi x

theorem secondaryKernelZero
    (D : E →ₗ[K] E) (i₀ : M →ₗ[K] E) (i₁ : H →ₗ[K] E)
    (p₀ : E →ₗ[K] M) (N : Submodule K E)
    (i₀mem : ∀ x, i₀ x ∈ N) (i₁mem : ∀ y, i₁ y ∈ N)
    (exactN : ∀ z, z ∈ N → D z = 0 → ∃ u, D u = z)
    (pi₀ : ∀ x, p₀ (i₀ x) = x) (pi₁ : ∀ y, p₀ (i₁ y) = 0)
    (pD : ∀ u, p₀ (D u) = 0)
    (x : M) (y : H) (himage : D (i₀ x) = D (i₁ y)) :
    x = 0 := by
  have hclosed : D (i₀ x - i₁ y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, himage, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ :=
    exactN (i₀ x - i₁ y) (N.sub_mem (i₀mem x) (i₁mem y)) hclosed
  have h := congrArg p₀ hu
  simpa [pi₀, pi₁, pD] using h.symm

end Linear

section Separation

variable {J W : Type*} [Fintype J]

theorem strictChamberDetect
    (ρ : W → (J → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (J → ℝ))
    (e : J → ℝ) (s : W → J → ℝ)
    (η : (J → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (cover : η ≠ 0 → ∃ (w : W) (a : J → ℝ),
      (∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) ∧ (∃ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      ∀ v, η v = - ∑ j, a j * (ρ w v) j)
    (strict : ∀ w j, 0 < (ρ w (e - s w)) j)
    (hne : η ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w, η (e - s w) < 0 := by
  obtain ⟨w, a, ha, ⟨j, hj⟩, hη⟩ := cover hne
  have hsum : 0 < ∑ k, a k * (ρ w (e - s w)) k := by
    exact Finset.sum_pos'
      (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (ha k) (le_of_lt (strict w k)))
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, mul_pos hj (strict w j)⟩
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  rw [hη]
  linarith

theorem finiteSeparation [Nonempty W]
    (ρ : W → (J → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (J → ℝ))
    (e : J → ℝ) (s : W → J → ℝ)
    (η : (J → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (B H : ℝ)
    (cover : η ≠ 0 → ∃ (w : W) (a : J → ℝ),
      (∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) ∧ (∃ j, 0 < a j) ∧
      ∀ v, η v = - ∑ j, a j * (ρ w v) j)
    (strict : ∀ w j, 0 < (ρ w (e - s w)) j)
    (hB : B ≤ 0) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (ineq : ∀ w, H ≤ B + η (e - s w)) :
    η = 0 ∧ B = 0 ∧ H = 0 := by
  have hη : η = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := strictChamberDetect ρ e s η cover strict hne
    have hi := ineq w
    linarith
  have hi := ineq (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty W))
  simp only [hη, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] at hi
  exact ⟨hη, by linarith, by linarith⟩

theorem topVanishes {S : Type*} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (C : S → S → ℝ) (j : S) (m m' : S → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (diag : C j j = 2)
    (outside : ∀ i, i ≠ j → m' i = m i)
    (oldrow : ∑ i, C j i * m i = 0)
    (newrow : ∑ i, C j i * m' i = 0)
    (count : m' j = m j - (∑ i, C j i * m i) + t) :
    t = 0 := by
  have point (i : S) :
      C j i * m' i = C j i * m i +
        if i = j then 2 * (m' j - m j) else 0 := by
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl, diag]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg h, outside i h, add_zero]
  have rows :
      (∑ i, C j i * m' i) =
        (∑ i, C j i * m i) + 2 * (m' j - m j) := by
    calc
      (∑ i, C j i * m' i) =
          ∑ i, (C j i * m i +
            if i = j then 2 * (m' j - m j) else 0) := by
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => point i)
      _ = (∑ i, C j i * m i) + 2 * (m' j - m j) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp
  rw [oldrow] at count
  linarith

end Separation

inductive MovePath {State : Type*} (R : State → State → Prop) :
    ℕ → State → State → Prop
  | nil (s : State) : MovePath R 0 s s
  | cons {n : ℕ} {s t u : State} :
      R s t → MovePath R n t u → MovePath R (n + 1) s u

theorem MovePath.append {State : Type*} {R : State → State → Prop}
    {n m : ℕ} {s t u : State}
    (p : MovePath R n s t) (q : MovePath R m t u) :
    MovePath R (n + m) s u := by
  induction p generalizing m u with
  | nil => simpa using q
  | cons h p ih =>
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      MovePath.cons h (ih q)

theorem rankStage {State : Type*}
    (R : State → State → Prop) (Good Done : State → Prop)
    (rank : State → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
    (bound : ∀ s, rank s ≤ L)
    (step : ∀ s, Good s → ¬ Done s →
      ∃ t, R s t ∧ rank t = rank s + 1)
    (fuel : ℕ) :
    ∀ s, rank s + fuel = L →
      ∃ n t, n ≤ fuel ∧ MovePath R n s t ∧ (¬ Good t ∨ Done t) := by
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro s hs
    by_cases stop : ¬ Good s ∨ Done s
    · exact ⟨0, s, by omega, MovePath.nil s, stop⟩
    · have hg : Good s := by tauto
      have hd : ¬ Done s := by tauto
      obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := step s hg hd
      have hb := bound t
      omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro s hs
    by_cases stop : ¬ Good s ∨ Done s
    · exact ⟨0, s, by omega, MovePath.nil s, stop⟩
    · have hg : Good s := by tauto
      have hd : ¬ Done s := by tauto
      obtain ⟨t, hst, ht⟩ := step s hg hd
      have hf : rank t + fuel = L := by omega
      obtain ⟨n, u, hn, hp, hu⟩ := ih t hf
      exact ⟨n + 1, u, by omega, MovePath.cons hst hp, hu⟩

theorem boundedStagesEscape {State : Type*}
    (R : State → State → Prop) (Good : State → Prop)
    (Inv : ℕ → State → Prop) (N L : ℕ)
    (stage : ∀ d, d < N → ∀ s, Inv d s → Good s →
      ∃ n t, n ≤ L ∧ MovePath R n s t ∧
        (¬ Good t ∨ Inv (d + 1) t))
    (boundary : ∀ s, Inv N s → ¬ Good s)
    (s₀ : State) (initial : Inv 0 s₀) :
    ∃ n t, n ≤ N * L ∧ MovePath R n s₀ t ∧ ¬ Good t := by
  have aux : ∀ k d s, d + k = N → Inv d s →
      ∃ n t, n ≤ k * L ∧ MovePath R n s t ∧ ¬ Good t := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro d s hd hi
      have hd' : d = N := by omega
      subst d
      exact ⟨0, s, by simp, MovePath.nil s, boundary s hi⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro d s hd hi
      by_cases hg : Good s
      · obtain ⟨n, t, hn, hp, ht⟩ := stage d (by omega) s hi hg
        rcases ht with hbad | hnext
        · refine ⟨n, t, ?_, hp, hbad⟩
          rw [Nat.succ_mul]
          omega
        · obtain ⟨m, u, hm, hq, hu⟩ := ih (d + 1) t (by omega) hnext
          refine ⟨n + m, u, ?_, hp.append hq, hu⟩
          rw [Nat.succ_mul]
          omega
      · exact ⟨0, s, Nat.zero_le _, MovePath.nil s, hg⟩
  exact aux N 0 s₀ (by omega) initial

#print axioms middleExact
#print axioms middleExactAcyclic
#print axioms secondaryKernelZero
#print axioms strictChamberDetect
#print axioms finiteSeparation
#print axioms topVanishes
#print axioms rankStage
#print axioms boundedStagesEscape

end NullLayerAudit

claims.natural_statement: At any capped representative with the target exterior data, choose one negative reduced lift G_w for every w in W_J. The proof of cap:hull constructs actual supported subrepresentation families S_w with folded vectors s_w such that (m_J^q(G_w z)-c_J)=(w(e-s_w))_J, where e=m_I^q(z)-c. Thus strict lower bounds at these finitely many representatives, not the whole coset, supply all strict chamber tests.

Under the finite strict Weyl-lift tests of N_FINITE_HULL, any lower family layer with zero socle on J has zero boundary(I) counts, zero J Cartan rows, and zero linear Hom both ways with the current q-layer summand M. This follows directly by choosing a chamber for the negative row functional; no topological interior or universal coset hypothesis is required.

For nonempty spherical J and any actual representative z capped at integer q on I and boundary(I) with target exterior level-q counts c, let d_min be the lowest initially occupied family level, d_b the lowest occupied boundary(I) level, N=d_b-d_min+1, and L=length(w_J). For any fixed choice of negative reduced lifts G_w, some cap-preserving positive word u in J of length at most N L and some w in W_J satisfy m_j^q(G_w u z)<=c_j for at least one j in J; G_w has length at most L. All prefixes of u and the final negative lift preserve the cap. For empty J the exterior configuration cannot occur. This is a general finite-witness theorem, not a bounded experiment.

claims.natural_statement: For arbitrary compatible block sizes, the D, Dbar, i, p, h matrices in exact_certificate.json satisfy D squared=Dbar squared=0, Di=iDbar, pD=Dbar p, pi=1 and ip+Dh+hD=1 using exactly d squared=rd=tr=t squared=0, tj=jt and tk=kt. Thus they give a uniform actual chain-homotopy equivalence, without assuming any finite nilpotence bound on j.

In the actual single-label remote-frame diagram S={a,b,k}, m_ab=infinity, m_ak=3, m_bk=2, X={a,b}, I={a,b}, J={b}, c=(1,1), q=1, the complexes E(b^(-n) a^2 k) for every n>=1 have the explicit minimal model C_n of theorem.md, lowest level 1-n and fixed occupied boundary level 0. Both finite Weyl-lift tests remain strict until exactly n positive b moves have been made. Every prefix in action order preserves the cap. Consequently the positive budget N length(w_J) is sharp for every N>=1; this is a universal construction, not a finite experiment.
